ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) distribution with a high contrast ratio limited to distal tip clusters. Approximately 92% of the visible surface consists of low-intensity pixels vs 8% high-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region across both lobes. Discrete high-intensity (white/light grey) geometric blobs are localized at the extreme distal tips (left and right) and in a diffuse mottled pattern around the axial median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration map. Approximately 11-13 primary peaks per lobe with pixel-amplitudes varying between 10 to 25 pixels, creating a jagged, irregular sawtooth boundary isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward concave sweep from the median notch, transitioning into a sharp convex curve at the lateral margins toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast white pixel clusters with circular morphology identified at the distal terminus of both lobes, indicative of barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (low-contrast grey streaks) visible on the medial portion of the left ventral lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the fluke tips. Significant structural irregularity and possible tissue loss along the trailing edge serrations suggest chronic mechanical wear or previous predation attempts.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme degree of edge serration amplitude is highly unique, specifically the deep 'v' shaped notches between individual peaks on the outer third of each lobe.
